customer_feedback: The new analytics dashboard is blazing fast! Our leadership team reviewed quarterly metrics in half the usual time. Exceptional work.
Your billing department charged us twice for our enterprise tier this month! We opened a ticket 3 days ago with zero response. Unacceptable!
The tool is functional and does what we need, but the navigation menus are cluttered. It takes 4 clicks just to find saved reports.
Customer support rep Marcus solved our SSO setup issue in under 10 minutes. Extremely knowledgeable and courteous service.
CSV export keeps timing out when attempting to download more than 5,000 rows. We have to export in small batches which ruins our workflow.
Would love to see a native Slack notification integration for high-priority alerts. Currently we rely on email notifications which get lost.
App crashed twice during our live executive demo. Memory usage seems to spike uncontrollably when multiple tabs are open.
Onboarding was seamless. The interactive product tour and sandbox environment allowed our team of 25 to be productive on day one.
Pricing jumped 35% at renewal with virtually no notice. For a seed-stage startup, this is almost prohibitive. We might migrate to a competitor.
Search works well for exact keywords, but fuzzy search or typo tolerance is missing. If you misspell one letter it yields zero results.
AI sentiment tagging accuracy is shockingly good. Saved our CX ops team at least 15 manual hours every single week.
Password reset emails are delayed by 45 to 60 minutes. Our remote staff were locked out of their accounts during morning shift handover.
Dark mode looks sleek and reduces eye strain. Please bring the same dark mode aesthetic to the exported PDF reports.
The mobile view is practically unusable on iOS Safari. Table headers overlap with data cells and horizontal scrolling is broken.
Can you clarify whether webhooks retry on 504 gateway timeouts? The developer documentation is vague on backoff policies.
Data visualization capabilities are top tier. Being able to toggle between donut, bar, and trend charts on the fly is incredible.
Subscription auto-renewed even though I explicitly unticked the auto-renew checkbox in billing settings. I demand a prompt refund.
Solid platform with regular feature updates. Really appreciate the transparent engineering changelog shared every Friday.
Role-based access control (RBAC) is too rigid. We need read-only access for external auditors without giving them billing visibility.
Upgraded to the Gemini 2.5 powered analysis and our executive summaries read like they were written by a top McKinsey consultant.
Customer service chatbot is frustrating and keeps looping into pre-canned answers. Let me talk to an actual human representative!
The filter dropdown resets every time I switch tabs. Mildly annoying when conducting deep-dive investigation across multiple datasets.
Best feedback intelligence tool on the market. We replaced three disconnected SaaS subscriptions with this single platform.
API rate limit of 60 requests per minute is suffocating during our nightly batch synchronization. Can we get higher burst capacity?
Documentation code snippets for Python are clean and well commented. Would be great to also provide TypeScript SDK examples.
Lost 30 minutes of draft filter configurations because there is no auto-save or URL state persistence. Extremely frustrating.
The Excel multi-sheet export feature is gorgeous. Our VP of Product was blown away by the formatted KPI cards and color-coded themes.
Search index appears to lag behind by 20 minutes when new feedback is ingested. Real-time should mean real-time.
Pricing per seat makes sense for core operators, but charging full price for casual stakeholders who just view dashboards is steep.
Shoutout to the support team for restoring our accidentally deleted workspace within 15 minutes on a Sunday afternoon. Lifesavers!
The latest UI update moved buttons around without warning. Our frontline agents are making mistakes because muscle memory was broken.
Clustering customer pain points automatically has helped our sprint planning immensely. We now prioritize features based on real data.
Two-factor authentication SMS codes frequently fail to arrive for international phone numbers (+44 and +49 country codes).
We tested the Gemini-driven root cause analysis on 2,000 survey comments. It spotted an checkout friction bug that our QA team missed.
Export to Excel works great, but can we get automated weekly email delivery of the report to executive stakeholders?
Invoices do not include our registered European VAT ID number despite entering it in tax settings. Our accounting department is holding payments.
Keyboard shortcuts for navigating records (J/K to move up/down) would make reviewing feedback much faster for power users.
The responsiveness of this web application is unmatched. Tables render instantly even with thousands of rows.
Lack of HubSpot integration means our marketing team has to manually copy customer sentiment notes. High friction.
Clean, distraction-free UI. No useless gimmicks, just accurate customer feedback intelligence and actionable insights.
Data synchronization with Postgres warehouse failed silently overnight. No error alert was dispatched to our webhook.
Would appreciate an option to customize the sentiment classification threshold for borderline neutral remarks.
The ability to upload raw CSV files and immediately map columns visually without technical assistance is a game changer.
Font contrast in secondary labels is slightly too dim in low-light environments. Needs WCAG AA compliance audit.
Strong customer intelligence engine. We share the pain-point priority list directly with our engineering managers every Monday.
Your platform logged our entire organization out during business hours due to an expired SSL certificate. Highly unprofessional.
The actionable recommendations generated by Gemini are surprisingly pragmatic and tailored to our industry.
Good overall platform, but would love to have multi-language support since 25% of our customer reviews are in Spanish and German.
Cannot delete old test datasets from our project dashboard. The delete confirmation modal freezes upon submission.
Speed, accuracy, and executive Excel exports are the three pillars that made our team adopt this company-wide. 10/10.
